title: Export a Meta ads carousel handoff file
description: Writes meta-carousel.json beside the slides of a rendered carousel (id): 2 to 10 cards with a headline each, the message, the call to action, and three placeholders to fill in (pageId, instagramUserId, link). Returns the file, the spec and any warnings, such as slides that are not square. Never uploads, never contacts Meta, never holds a token.
phrases: export this carousel for meta ads
make the meta ads handoff for my carousel
turn the carousel into a meta carousel ad spec
prepare these slides as a facebook ad
write the ad handoff file for instagram ads

safety.rule: Writes one local JSON file only. Never uploads and never contacts Meta.
safety.notes: The export must already be rendered. The file replaces an earlier meta-carousel.json in the same export folder. No network calls.
